hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Protocol vaults. In beforeSwap, it fully handles swap execution by taking input tokens from the PoolManager, depositing them into an EVault, withdrawing output tokens from another EVault, and returning a custom BeforeSwapDelta — enforcing a configurable curve invariant on pool reserves.
